name: FY27 - AI Driven Test Automation Engineering Intern
jobDescription:
Job Description

The MACE QA and Test Development team is seeking a talented and motivated student.

In this role, you will design and develop intelligent tools and AI agents to enhance debugging, automate test workflows, and improve system-level validation. You will combine software development, data analysis, and applied AI.

Key Responsibilities

Implement tools and scripts (primarily in Python) to improve test efficiency, coverage, and scalability.

Minimum Qualifications

Student pursuing a B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.

At least 2 year remaining until graduation | Minimum 3 days a week at office.

Strong programming skills (Python preferred).
